scope: Immutable geographic DTO, optional canonical trip references and pure atomic domain edits. No provider/catalog/API/LLM integration is claimed.
implemented: Frozen extra-forbid CityRefSnapshot and nested Open-Meteo/admin/LiteAPI/Duffel bindings; strict positive Int32 source ID and deterministic geo:openmeteo:<id>.
Exact country ISO, provider-country consistency, populated-place PPL* feature, finite WGS84 coordinates and optional verified-IANA timezone; missing labels/timezones do not create inferred facts.
Empty location_refs and None endpoint IDs are excluded, preserving old JSON serialization.
Parent trip graph validates key/ref identity, exact display label/ref pair, and ordered route endpoint identities, including same-name cities in different countries.
apply_operations server-only resolved_places argument validates and merges snapshots before intermediate edits; no operation can write snapshot records.
Derived route rebuilding propagates endpoint refs by position, matches identities instead of labels, and retains corresponding existing modes/IDs.
Same selected physical ID with changed snapshot/version is rejected to prevent implicit catalog refresh from rewriting a trip.
open_boundaries: DTO structural validation does not prove snapshot provenance. Before enabling/deploying public global-city input, API/Store must verify exact snapshot id/version/payload against the durable catalog; unverified initial_trip refs must be refused.
Current LLM schema/wire and provider adapters are unchanged; no global conversational search or availability claim.
Public legacy route_edges triples preserve compatibility but cannot alone disambiguate homonymous physical endpoints; downstream dynamic provider code must consume owned place refs.
Explicit re-selection of a newer catalog version within an existing trip needs a separate authorized transition; automatic refresh is deliberately refused.
MAX_LOCATION_REFS32 is an engineering bound, not world geographic coverage or an approved product cap.
The controlled fixture geography is declared test data; these pure checks are not actual provider-resolved CityRef evidence.
